question: When does the Income-tax Act, 2025 come into force?
reference_answer: Save as otherwise provided, it comes into force on 1st April, 2026.

gold.quote: it shall come into force on the 1st April, 2026

author: claude-draft

question: What is the territorial extent of the Income-tax Act, 2025?
reference_answer: It extends to the whole of India.

gold.quote: This Act may be called the Income-tax Act, 2025. (2) It extends to the whole of India

author: claude-draft

question: How does the Income-tax Act, 2025 define a tax year?
reference_answer: The twelve-month period of the financial year commencing on 1st April (with special rules for newly set up businesses or new sources of income).

gold.quote: means the twelve months period of the financial year commencing on the 1st April

author: claude-draft

question: For a business newly set up during a financial year, when does its first tax year begin and end?
reference_answer: It begins on the date the business or profession is set up (or the new source of income comes into existence) and ends with that financial year.

gold.quote: the date of setting up of such business or profession

author: claude-draft

question: How many days must an individual be in India in a tax year to be resident under the basic day-count test?
reference_answer: A total period of 182 days or more in that tax year.

gold.quote: is in India for a total period of one hundred and eighty-two days or more in that tax year

author: claude-draft

question: Apart from the 182-day rule, what other stay condition makes an individual resident in India?
reference_answer: Being in India for 60 days or more in the year and 365 days or more in total in the four preceding tax years (with exceptions for crew members, employment abroad and visiting Indian citizens/PIOs).

gold.quote: is in India cumulatively for sixty days or more during that year and has been in India cumulatively for three hundred and sixty-five days or more

author: claude-draft

question: What income is included in the total income of a non-resident?
reference_answer: Income from any source that is received or deemed received in India in that year, or that accrues or arises or is deemed to accrue or arise to them in India in that year.

gold.quote: the total income of a tax year of a person, who is a non-resident, includes all income from whatever source derived

author: claude-draft

question: How is income apportioned between spouses governed by the Portuguese Civil Code in Goa?
reference_answer: Income is not assessed as that of the community of property; income under each head other than Salaries is divided equally between husband and wife, while salary income is taxed in the hands of the spouse who earned it.

gold.quote: shall be divided equally between the husband and the wife

author: claude-draft

question: In which tax year is an interim dividend deemed to be income?
reference_answer: In the tax year in which the amount is unconditionally made available by the company to the member entitled to it.

gold.quote: any interim dividend shall be deemed to be the income of the tax year in which the amount of such dividend is unconditionally made available

author: claude-draft

question: Who is an assessee under the Income-tax Act, 2025?
reference_answer: A person by whom any tax or other sum of money is payable under the Act, including the further categories listed in the definition.

gold.quote: means a person by whom any tax or any other sum of money is payable under this Act

author: claude-draft

question: What does the term business include under the Income-tax Act, 2025?
reference_answer: Any trade, commerce or manufacture, or any adventure or concern in the nature of trade, commerce or manufacture.

gold.quote: includes any trade, commerce or manufacture or any adventure or concern in the nature of trade

reference_answer: Schedule VIII, subject to the conditions specified in it.

gold.quote: any income enumerated in Schedule VIII shall not be included

question: What documentary condition must be met to claim input tax credit under the CGST Act?

question: How is aggregate turnover defined in the CGST Act?

question: Which NBFCs fall in the Base Layer under Scale Based Regulation?

gold.quote: non-deposit taking NBFCs below the asset size of ₹1,000 crore

question: Which NBFCs are placed in the Middle Layer?

gold.quote: all deposit taking NBFCs (NBFCs-D), irrespective of asset size

question: What asset size places an NBFC in the Upper Layer?
